scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance in Implementation of Information and Communication Technology (ICT)
other_conditions: Must be a Micro, Small, or Medium enterprise.
Must be run by an SC or ST entrepreneur, with at least 51% contribution from the SC/ST entrepreneur.
Must plan to implement ICT solutions such as hardware for cloud computing and networking.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance covering up to 75% of ICT capital expenditure, capped at ₹5,00,000.
